description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchClientBuilder class, which generates and configures Elasticsearch clients, including loading configuration from files or global settings, and sanitizing host URLs.

classes.name: ElasticSearchClientBuilder
classes.description: A class that provides static methods to create and configure Elasticsearch clients, load configuration, and sanitize host URLs.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a preconfigured Elasticsearch client, loading hosts from configuration if not already loaded.

methods.name: sanitizeHost
methods.description: Standardizes and validates a host configuration, ensuring it has a proper URL scheme and format.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads Elasticsearch host configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: loadFromArray
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of host configurations.

methods.name: loadFromSugarConfig
methods.description: Loads Elasticsearch configuration from the global $sugar_config variable.

methods.name: loadDefaultConfig
methods.description: Provides default configuration (localhost) if no other config is available.

methods.name: addHttp
methods.description: Ensures a URL has an HTTP or HTTPS scheme, adding 'http://' if missing.
